Event Rules and Privacy Agreement

Conditions

  1. Submitted details must be accurate.
  2. Events publish immediately after submission.
  3. Schedule conflicts show warnings but do not prevent posting.
  4. Blocked dates and times prevent submission.

Privacy

Basic events show public calendar details. Internal events remain visible only to the posting organization and admin. Contact details, organization notes, concerns, and admin notes remain restricted.
